text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*... In the world-stage 'Japan Cup',
I managed to run this far...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna decide on my dream too!
My very own dream is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering an Overseas G1"!
...How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: We did it at the Japan Cup, so why not go all the way? On the way back, we can get tons of souvenirs~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And 'space travel' might be nice too.
Very fitting for Universe-chan."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If I'm the first one there, maybe I'll even
get some land on the moon~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
How about "giving back to your parents"?
Like treating them to a vacation trip~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Two days and one night, breakfast and dinner included.
Maybe a "repaying the favor" pattern like Kris S...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Eeeeeh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't all of these sound like you just made them up on the spot?
And ripped them off from someone else, too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ um~, I don't really have anything
I particularly want to do, you know?
I'm just an ordinary girl after all~.
Despite having put in a great run, Hishi Miracle was clutching her head on the track.

Meanwhile, across the racecourse,
other Umamusume were discussing
their upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Kris S. You're going, aren't you?
To the Arima Kinen, after this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. Hishi Miracle has yet to find her Mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Next time—might just be my chance.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah, you never know.
When it comes to races, that is...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You'd be surprised—sometimes the airheaded ones
run the best races!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is entering "cryosleep."
Until next spring. So――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
For the Arima Kinen, I want to "entrust" it to someone.
To my classmate... my "bestie for life."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Uni-san!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I have received the sword!
As the successor to the star, I will run with pride!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Muhyo~, what a heart-fluttering relay,
from Universe-san to the book-loving hero Rob Roy-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I absolutely have to see this through right on the track~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me. Can I leave you in charge
of being the vendor for the year-end event?

Rivals had already begun making their moves
for the decisive year-end battle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-ah, so in the end, am I the only one
who couldn't find a dream?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
It was nowhere to be found for so long,
it's not like it'd just turn up out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Fan
text_block_list.text: Hishi Miracle-eees!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, yes!?
Who's that mister over there...?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Fan
text_block_list.text: Let me dream again, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That surprised me...
Still, I see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I haven't found my own dream yet,
but there are people out there dreaming for me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's just... kind of weird.
And yet...
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't find it.
However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm starting to understand a bit.
...Just a tiny bit, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: “My dream really isn't about copying someone else...”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If you don't believe it from the bottom of your heart, then it's not really a dream, is it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like there's no point in trying to act bigger than I am.
For example~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Okonomiyaki is delicious. Being with someone is fun.
Beyond that kind of "ordinary"...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: My dream is surely...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know what that is.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, won't you go with me?
To the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: All I know is that there are people dreaming of me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You're saying you wanna rise to the occasion, huh!

The search for a dream is—still underway.
Will something be found by race day,
or will it come down to playing it by ear?

Either way, at the year's grand finale—
the Arima Kinen—I'll show them the ultimate miracle.
